slides.title: Success, Careers, and Personal Growth
bullets: Prepare to read, discuss and write
slides.narration: Welcome to Grade 7 English, Unit 7: Success, Careers, and Personal Growth. In this unit you will explore what it means to succeed, how people build meaningful careers, and how personal growth shapes the choices we make. You will read about real-world career paths, discuss what makes a person truly successful, and discover that success is not only about money or fame — it is also about dedication, resilience, and the contribution you make to your community. In this short lecture, preview the key ideas and prepare for the independent lesson.

slides.title: What you will achieve
bullets: Read and understand a passage about careers and success, and discuss its ideas in English.
Use adjective + preposition combinations correctly (e.g., *interested in*, *proud of*, *responsible for*).
Understand and use verb patterns with infinitives (*to do*) and gerunds (*doing*).
slides.narration: By the end of this unit, you will be able to read and understand a passage about careers and success, and discuss its ideas in English. You will also use adjective + preposition combinations correctly (e.g., *interested in*, *proud of*, *responsible for*). You will also understand and use verb patterns with infinitives (*to do*) and gerunds (*doing*). Keep these goals in mind as you work.

slides.title: Language for precise thinking
slides.narration: Your vocabulary work begins with these words: ambition, dedication, perseverance, achievement, milestone, distinction. Listen to each pronunciation in the vocabulary lab, study its meaning in context, and use the word accurately in your own discussion and writing.

slides.title: Read critically
slides.narration: The reading sequence includes Building a Future and An Interview About Careers. Read actively. Identify each text's central ideas, notice viewpoint and reliability, and support every inference with relevant evidence from the text.

slides.title: Adjective + Preposition — The Basics
bullets: Many English adjectives must be followed by one fixed partner preposition: we say interested in, never interested about, and proud of, never proud for....
slides.narration: The first language focus is Adjective + Preposition — The Basics. Many English adjectives must be followed by one fixed partner preposition: we say interested in, never interested about, and proud of, never proud for. Learning each pair as a single phrase makes your writing about success and careers sound natural and accurate. Notice the structure in the model examples, then apply it deliberately in connected sentences and paragraphs.

slides.title: Use English for a real purpose
bullets: Explain, support and improve your ideas
slides.narration: In speaking, you will complete Speaking 1: Present Your Career Choice. Organise your ideas, use evidence and respond clearly to questions. In writing, you will plan, draft, check and revise. Use the success criteria before submitting your work.

slides.title: You are ready to begin
bullets: Activities, quiz and optional live sessions
slides.narration: You are ready to begin. Start with the vocabulary lab, continue through reading and comprehension, apply the grammar focus, and complete the speaking and writing practices. Use AI English for hints and feedback any time, and bring your questions to a live session too if you join one.
